correctness.rationale: From downset counting the weight of T is 2^|T|-2^|S∩T|=2^a(2^b-1), inclusion-monotone. The nonempty face poset sublevel order complex is the barycentric subdivision of the filtered simplicial complex. Fix v in S. For each face sigma avoiding v the integral basis c_sigma=boundary[v,sigma], [v,sigma] is upper triangular with unit diagonal and filtration-compatible: a codimension-one face tau gives w({v}∪tau)<=w(sigma); w({v}∪sigma)=2w(sigma). Differential consists only of unit pairs, hence complete Z interval splitting including ties, H0 essential [v], and zero torsion. Independent brute-force mod-two boundary reductions for all n=2..6 and every center size agreed with the precise bar multiset; those finite checks do not prove all n or integral freeness independently.
